========================================
> DEBIAN DSA                            
  Debian: Apache2 Security Patch        
                                        
  Debian maintainers have issued an     
  urgent update for the apache2 HTTP    
  server package. The DSA-6620-1        
  advisory remediates critical remote   
  security flaws across stable          
  production releases.                  
                                        
  Source: Debian DSA (2026-11-12)
